name: @qantrip/cloud
description: Nekro Qantrip 官网、账号与端到端加密同步服务（Cloudflare Worker）

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --strict-vars false --env-file .dev.vars.example && react-router typegen && tsc -b
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging react-router build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: react-router build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
